question:
B. Is this measure already running in Lapland wellbeing services county (or in the OYS university hospital area that treats its patients)?
A. Does recent evidence support the size of effect we assume: does this measure raise the share of lung cancer patients who get curative-intent treatment, and by how much?
Measure: Fitness assessment and prehabilitation before deciding against curative treatment. Before a stage I-III patient is judged too frail, they get an exercise test, a geriatric assessment if over 75, and four weeks of supervised exercise, breathing training and help to stop smoking. Then the decision is made again.
effect_summary_en: Cochrane (2022): exercise before surgery cuts the risk of lung complications after surgery (RR 0.45), but no study measures a rise in the share treated with curative intent.
supported_en: A 2022 Cochrane review of 10 trials found that exercise before lung cancer surgery cuts lung complications after surgery (risk ratio 0.45) and shortens the hospital stay by about 2.2 days.
not_supported_en: No page shows that prehabilitation raises the share of patients who get curative treatment, so the 0.5-point gain is not confirmed.
in_use_summary_en: No public sign of it: the OYS lung cancer pathway lists lung function and other illnesses as reasons not to operate, but it describes no prehabilitation or repeat fitness assessment.
summary_en: I found no public sign that Lapland or OYS runs prehabilitation for lung cancer patients. The OYS lung cancer pathway page says lung function and other illnesses can rule out surgery, but it describes no exercise test, geriatric assessment, prehabilitation or second decision. On effect, a 2022 Cochrane review found that exercise before lung surgery lowers the risk of lung complications (risk ratio 0.45), but it did not measure how many more patients become fit for curative treatment.
unanswered_en: I did not find any Lapha or OYS page that mentions lung cancer prehabilitation, a repeat fitness assessment or a geriatric assessment, and I found no decision about one; a final search turned up only general advice on stopping smoking before surgery.
